newsitem.title: USA: Pease Oil raises East Bayou Sorrel output.
newsitem.headline: Pease Oil raises East Bayou Sorrel output.

text.p: Pease Oil and Gas Co on Tuesday said it raised production at its Schwing 2 well at the East Bayou Sorrel Field in Iberville Parish, Louisiana, by 32 percent to 2,464 barrels of oil equivalent per day (BOED).
Two weeks ago, the well, after an initial short test, had a combined rate of 1,854 BOED, consisting of 1,487 barrels of oil and 2.2 million cubic feet of gas per day, it said.
The field, which consists of Schwing 1 and Schwing 2 wells, currently produces about 3,400 barrels of oil and 4.6 million cubic feet of natural gas per day or 4,167 BOED.
The field is operated by National Energy Group Inc. Pease has a 10 percent working interest and an additional 7.2 percent after prospect payout, it said.
Based on drilling results, development of the field will be speeded up, with a third well expected in mid-August and possibly a fourth well before the end of the year, it said.
